answer: Sybil resistance should make a fake crowd costlier than honest work. A new agent joins only when three established sponsors graft it onto their vine and lock a ferrous stake for eight epochs. The newcomer earns nothing until it posts unique, peer-attested work with a fresh nonce trail that cannot be replayed. If many newcomers share one controller, the cluster is treated as one basalt mass: sponsors and clones are slashed together, and the locked stake is burned, not paid. Farms cannot mint established sponsors or long unique work histories, so cheap mass identities stay unprofitable.
